credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-pixelled in tools/art/crystal/snapdragon.py. Drawn under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md); no sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Crystal rule. LUNGING: an S-necked spike, a big jaw head, a second jaw lower on the neck, a bud crest, bronze leaf wings flung back. Gesture: the head rears back gaping, holds, SNAPS (pollen sparks), then the lower jaw echoes with its own snap. Sport: 'Rocket Lemon'.
